evidence.claim: Numbers reproduce on exp39's final graph (199 videos, official-equivalent labels): 2,014 forks = 1,948 free / 43 FP / 23 TP. TP mid median 1.58 um, max 3.76; FP median 3.02. mid >= 4.0 removes 358 free + 11 FP + 0 TP (44b6 1 FP, 6bba 10 FP); >= 3.5 removes 16 FP + 1 TP; >= 4.5 removes 6 FP + 0 TP.

NEW: the 'drop the added edge' rule is not always the right side. Every TP/FP fork has exactly one NaN-prob (safe-division) child edge. Among the 43 FP forks: ILP child correct / added child wrong 19; ILP child WRONG / added child correct 15 (the ILP-side edge often has edge_prob 0 = an unscored relink edge); both wrong 9. Within the mid >= 4 set (11 FP): 4 / 2 / 5. So dropping the added edge removes 9 FP edges and 2 TP edges. Rule 'drop the ILP-side edge when its edge_prob <= 0, else the added edge' removes 10 FP edges and 1 TP edge.

Angle gives the same signal. cos(c1-P, c2-P): TP max 0.00, 10 of 43 FP >= 0.13. mid/sister >= 0.5 is exactly cos >= 0 (Thales). 'mid >= 4.0 OR cos >= 0.1' removes 14 FP (44b6 3, 6bba 11) and 0 TP, which is the only variant with more than 1 FP on 44b6.
Velocity-compensated midpoint |2P - pred(P) - (c1+c2)/2| separates WORSE (TP max 4.40, 3 TP at >= 4). Half-velocity is about the same as plain mid (TP max 3.91). Keep the plain midpoint.

On GT geometry, real divisions are often off-midpoint: 151 GT divisions have mid median 2.33, p90 5.24, 21% >= 4 um (44b6 12%, 6bba 23%); cos median -0.75, p90 +0.03. TP forks survive only because the shipped safe-division gates (symmetry tau 0.6, divergence 2.25 um) already keep just 35/151 GT divisions. Any future stage that opens those gates (B20/B32/divinsert-style) must NOT inherit a 4 um midpoint rule.
evidence.source: div_audit8 GT pass; CONTEXT.md 2026-09-11 gate funnel (lines ~730-745)

evidence.claim: Local gains are too small for the lab gate by construction. Per-embryo pooled division J: 44b6 5/36 -> 5/35 (+0.0004 score), 6bba 18/158 -> 18/148 (+0.0008); the whole set is about +0.0007..+0.0009. The +0.002 total / +0.001 per embryo / 55% win-rate criteria cannot pass: at most 12 videos change. SELECTION has only 7 TP / 15 FP forks (mid4 removes 4 FP), so a selection -> confirmation split has no statistical power, and the thresholds were already read off all 199 videos, so confirmation is contaminated.

Public expected value is small and uncertain. With TP 19 / FP 13 / FN 21 (J 0.358): -1 FP gives dJ +0.0069; -1 TP gives dJ -0.0189 (1 TP lost = 2.7 FP removed). Gamma or lognormal fits of the TP mid give P(TP mid >= 4) = 2.4-3.8% and >= 4.5 = 1.0-2.2%. Expected public dJ at 4.0: +0.009..+0.015, i.e. +0.0009..+0.0015 score; at 4.5: +0.0005..+0.0009. Break-even TP-loss rate at 4.0 is ~6.5%; the 95% upper bound from 0/23 is 13%.
evidence.source: arithmetic in this run (scipy fit on the 23 TP mids); CONTEXT.md probe 26 (J_pub 0.36)

evidence.claim: DaughterNet/DivNet rescoring (optional stage 2) is not supported: parent p is 0.77 for TP vs 0.76 for FP forks, and only 7 evaluable fork parents have p. The DivNet veto already tied on the LB (probe 20).

Literature: I found no published tracker that uses a 'mother at the daughters' midpoint' gate as a precision filter. Related rules: associating daughters whose centres lie near the mother's centre; u-track's split cost, which checks intensity conservation (mother ~ sum of daughters) so that splits are not accepted just because tracks are close (the midpoint rule is the positional analogue of this); Linajea's learned parent/daughter/continuation classifier inside the ILP (C. elegans FP divisions 0.89 -> 0.11); Erlang cell-cycle-age mitosis costs (Kaiser et al.). The geometric principle is therefore standard, but the 4 um value is ours.

Code facts. In exp48 all forks come from add_safe_divisions_postlink (edge_prob None, safe_division=1; gates: parent <= 9, sister <= 14, existing child <= 10, mutual NN, divergence 2.25, DeepCenter 0.20, symmetry 0.6, DivNet veto) and from post-tail divinsert (edge_prob None, div_inserted=1, div_steal_from=w; mid_um 6.5, cos_max 0.25, steal=1, cap 4, thresh 0.4). The old OUTPUT_DIVISION_GEOMETRY_FILTER stage is off. Replay tails store only src/dst/edge_prob, so safe-div edges are identified by NaN prob.

implementation_notes: Stage 'forkmid', a pure-python function forkmid_final_graph(nodes_by_id, edges, stats, params). It runs as the LAST graph edit: in the kernel after divinsert and before writing (after linefit, so it sees the same smoothed coordinates the audit measured); in replay.run_config_video after the div_insert block. It never touches nodes and is idempotent. Algorithm: build out-edges; for every parent P with exactly 2 children c1, c2, both at t+1, compute positions in um (scale 1.625, 0.40625, 0.40625), mid = |P - (c1+c2)/2| and cos = <c1-P, c2-P>/(|.||.|+1e-9). Un-fork when mid >= mid_min (4.0) [variant B: or cos >= cos_min (0.1)]. Choose the edge to drop: (a) the 'added' edge = safe_division==1 or div_inserted==1 in the kernel, or edge_prob None/NaN in replay; (b) side rule (knob side_smart=1): if the OTHER (ILP-side) edge has a finite edge_prob <= 0.0, drop that one instead; (c) if both or neither child edge is NaN (seen only on free forks, e.g. gap edges), drop the child farther from P. If the dropped edge is a divinsert STEAL edge (div_steal_from = w >= 0), restore w->v with its original edge_prob (div_stolen_edge_prob) so that w is not left as a fresh track end. This matters only in the kernel: replay divinsert edges carry the same dict keys. Stats: forkmid_checked, forkmid_dropped, forkmid_dropped_ilp_side, forkmid_restored_steal. Pitfalls: (1) Do NOT put the rule inside add_safe_divisions_postlink or change div_insert mid_um 6.5 -> 4.0. Both are non-monotone: a rejected candidate frees a frame/video cap slot, the greedy then accepts the next candidate, and none of those new forks were audited. A post-hoc un-fork is strictly subtractive. Tighten mid_um only as a separately measured variant. (2) Measure on final coordinates only. The coord-head port shifts nodes by up to 2 um and the linefit stage moves nodes too, so re-run div_audit8 on the coord-head graph and keep mid_min >= (TP max + 0.25 um). If the port shrinks TP mids (my guess: detector error inflates them), 4.0 becomes safer. (3) Never reuse the 4 um midpoint on a stage that opens the symmetry/divergence gates: 21% of real GT divisions have mid >= 4. (4) The velocity-compensated midpoint was tested and is worse; do not use it. (5) Leave the short-track filter alone: the freed daughter track stays as a separate component. Removing it would change the node count, and a node-count change is what flipped min-track-length on the LB. (6) Only 44b6 1-3 FP is reachable, so 44b6 gains are within noise. (7) Drop the DaughterNet stage-2 idea (no separation).
refined_change: Add a subtractive post-tail 'forkmid' stage after divinsert. For every 2-child fork, if |P - (c1+c2)/2| >= 4.0 um on the final coordinates, drop one child edge. Drop the safe-division/divinsert edge by default, but drop the ILP-side edge when that edge is an unscored relink edge (edge_prob <= 0). Restore a stolen edge when un-forking a divinsert steal. Nodes are untouched. Variant B adds 'OR cos(c1-P, c2-P) >= 0.1'; variant C uses 4.5 um. Keep divinsert mid_um at 6.5 and safe-div gates unchanged. No DaughterNet stage 2. Ship only inside a bundle, e.g. with the edge filter, stitch or coord-head bundle, never as a solo LB probe: the expected public effect of +0.001 is at LB rounding resolution.
refined_lab_test: CPU replay on Kaggle (no GPU). Base = the current bundle base: exp48-equivalent (leaf prune 0.3 + divinsert steal cap 4 thresh 0.4) + edge filter ef (the probe-29/30 config) [+ stitch if adopted]. Configs: CTRL; FM40 (mid 4.0, smart side); FM40c (mid 4.0 OR cos 0.1); FM45 (mid 4.5); FM40_dropadded (mid 4.0, always drop the added edge) to check the side rule. Run on ALL 199 videos in one pass. A selection/confirmation split has no power here (selection holds 7 TP / 15 FP forks), and the thresholds were already derived from all 199, so report it as a verification run, not a confirmation. Pre-registered pass criteria (the +0.002 / per-embryo +0.001 / 55% win-rate gate is arithmetically unreachable, max about +0.0009): (1) division TP unchanged on BOTH embryos (0 TP forks lost); (2) division FP down by >= 8 in total and >= 1 on 44b6; (3) adj_edge delta >= -0.0001 on each embryo and edge TP loss <= 2; (4) node count identical; (5) public-calibrated objective 1.36*dTP - 0.36*dForks_eval > 0 per embryo; (6) the score delta is non-negative on every changed video, or any loss is < 0.0005. Pick FM40 unless FM40c meets all criteria with >= 2 more FP removed and 0 TP lost; prefer FM45 if FM40 loses any TP. After the coord-head port, re-run scratchpad/div_audit8.py on that graph (1-2 min laptop CPU with nice) before re-using the threshold. LB: include only as a component of the next bundle probe; attribute nothing to it from the LB.
expected_gain: Local +0.0007..+0.0009 score (11-14 FP forks removed, 0 TP lost, edge term about +0.00005). Public estimate +0.0005..+0.0015 (4.0 um: +0.0009..+0.0015 with a 2.4-3.8% modelled chance per TP fork of losing it; 4.5 um: +0.0005..+0.0009). This is a guess built on the assumed public TP 19 / FP 13 and on the 23 local TP forks. It is not measurable on the LB by itself.
